title: Equal sides do not prove square
hook: Which shape has equal diagonals in this example?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: A parallelogram can retain opposite side lengths while its corners skew. Its two diagonals differ unless the included angle is ninety degrees in this example; a diagonal comparison detects the skew.
